ai_insights.narrative: This SonarCloud portfolio covers 847 repositories across the defra and defragovuk organisations. The most material findings are a large volume of stale, unscanned repositories (357 inactive projects portfolio-wide, 109 of them inactive for over a year), weak auditability on suppressed issues (66 repositories with false positives lacking justification comments and 65 with unjustified accepted issues), and 59 repositories with configuration problems that block analysis altogether. Branch hygiene is also inconsistent, with 74 repositories scanning a non-standard main branch and 158 carrying inactive non-main branches. Technical fundamentals are comparatively stronger: only 12 repositories are on a non-compliant Quality Gate and only one custom quality profile issue was found across both organisations. The two decisions with the most impact are rationalising inactive/misconfigured repositories to reclaim licence headroom and cost, and enforcing justification comments on every suppressed issue to restore auditability.
